How Atelier Index Works Under the Hood

No neural network is trained per closet. Instead, a single frozen CLIP-ViT-B/32 vision-text model runs locally in your browser to turn garments into 512-D vectors, while two closed-form Dual Ridge Regression models (Aesthetic + ASHRAE 55 Thermal) learn your exact preferences in under a millisecond.

Model 1 · Style & Pairing

Weighted Dual Ridge + 512-D Pairwise Interactions

Simply averaging item vectors fails when A+B = good and C+D = good, yet A+D = bad. Multiplying each pair element-by-element (v_A ⊙ v_B) creates a distinct 512-D interaction vector for every combination.

  • Salience Weighting: Coats, tops, and bottoms carry `1.0` weight; shoes `0.85`; accessories `0.35` so small pieces accent rather than hijack the outfit vector.
  • Culprit Isolation: Tagging a clashing piece when rating adds targeted negative pair rows so innocent pieces aren't penalized.
  • Recency Decay (`W`): Exponential half-life (`30–90d`) shrinks older ratings' influence without changing raw CLIP similarity.
Model 2 · Thermal Comfort

ASHRAE 55 clo Physics + Dual Ridge Residual

Instead of arbitrary warmth heuristics, each garment gets a published ASHRAE 55 clo insulation estimate projected from CLIP (and blended with manual Warmth), stacked via empirical physics, then personalized by Dual Ridge over your thermal logs.

  • Zero-Log Cold Start: With 0 logs, ΔT = 0 so real ASHRAE insulation math still gives sensible temperature targets.
  • Automatic Accessory Filtering: Scarves/beanies project to ~`0.10 clo`; belts, bags, and sunglasses project to `0.00 clo`.
  • Try-On Safe: Logging `"Unknown (Try-on / Indoors)"` skips the thermal matrix so indoor tests never skew your weather curve.
Model 3 · Inspo & Gap Simulation

Crop-per-Slot 512-D Search & Counterfactual Gaps

In Inspo Match, dragging a box isolates each garment into its own clean 512-D vector (optionally nudged with CLIP text) and searches your entire closet without rigid category filters. In Gap Analysis, candidate buys are simulated across your wardrobe to measure unlock value.

Model 4 · Uncertainty & Masked Sizing

Why Score & Certainty Are Always Separate

Missing data is never faked with zeros. Missing sizing/fit dimensions (length, rise, ease) are masked out with `0` weight in similarity math—keeping Score unbiased while proportionally lowering Certainty.

  • Certainty Inputs: Tag/photo completeness (`40%`) + GP/Ridge posterior variance & neighbor proximity (`40%`) + wear-frequency evidence (`20%`, minus `14%` for unowned Wishlist/Try-Ons).
  • Pairing-Aware Sizing: Compares Size Down / Baseline / Size Up against selected closet pieces using both masked proportion compatibility and hard physical clearance checks (layering over thick knits, under tailored coats, or winter socks).
